video.title: AI欧腐《两个爸爸，一个娃/Two Daddies, One Baby》
video.desc:
中间有一集没声 原视频就没声 无解
After being disowned by his father and humiliated by the man he loved, the male lead moves to a quiet country house, only to find an abandoned newborn on the roadside. Unable to leave the baby, he decides to raise him alone. But their peaceful life is shattered when a powerful CEO arrives with a paternity test—the baby is his long‑lost nephew. When the baby refuses to leave the male lead, the CEO proposes a cohabitation contract: they will raise the child together until he adapts to city life. Moving into the CEO’s luxury villa, two very different men—one soft‑hearted and craving peace, the other cold and controlling—navigate unexpected family life.
Jesse被父亲断绝关系，又被深爱的人羞辱后，搬到乡下一座安静的小屋生活。没想到，他在路边发现了一个被遗弃的新生儿。
他不忍心丢下孩子，决定独自将宝宝抚养长大。可平静的生活很快被打破——一位强势的总裁带着亲子鉴定突然出现，证明这个孩子正是他失散已久的侄子。
当宝宝怎么也不肯离开Jesse时，总裁提出了一份同居契约：在孩子适应城市生活之前，两人暂时一起抚养他。
就这样，Jesse搬进了总裁的豪华别墅。一个温柔心软、只想安稳生活；一个冷漠强势、习惯掌控一切。两个截然不同的男人，因为一个孩子，被迫开始了一段意想不到的“共同养娃”生活。
